controles.affirmation: Hook/resume/titre bloc 1 : les deux corrections volontaires de 2026 portent sur 'le meme defaut de fabrication'
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K 26/05/2026 : "The two actions involved different manufacturing processes, both of which were related to cannula tears associated with cannula handling at the Company's Acton, Massachusetts facility." ; 10-Q T2 2026 note 7 : "we issued two voluntary medical device corrections (“MDCs”), one in March and the other in May related to separate manufacturing issues that caused a tear in the cannula of certain Omnipod products."
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'pour le meme defaut de fabrication' par 'pour deux defauts de fabrication distincts provoquant tous deux des dechirures de cannule'.

controles.affirmation: Quantitatif 1 : '50 M$ de couts totaux attendus sur l'annee pour ces deux corrections'
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K 26/05/2026 : "the Company expects to incur up to $50 million of costs associated with this correction in 2026" (cette correction = celle de mai uniquement). 10-Q T1 2026 : "We estimate the voluntary medical device correction and related costs will be approximately $30 million, more than half of which we expect to incur in 2026" (correction de mars).
controles.correction_proposee: 'jusqu'a 50 M$ de couts attendus en 2026 pour la seule correction de mai, auxquels s'ajoutent environ 30 M$ pour celle de mars'.

controles.affirmation: Externe 1, preuve citee comme verbatim : "...should the exemption that is currently in place for certain medical devices be eliminated, tariffs would have a material impact on our results of operations in future years" (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.verbatim_source: Le 10-Q T2 2026 (et le T1 2026) disent : "We do not expect tariffs to have a significant impact on our gross margin in 2026; however, the elimination of the current exemption for certain medical devices would have a material impact on our results of operations in future years." La formulation citee entre guillemets n'existe dans aucun des deux 10-Q.
controles.correction_proposee: Substance exacte, mais remplacer la citation par le verbatim reel ci-dessus.

controles.affirmation: Deux corrections volontaires les 12 mars et 26 mai 2026, dechirures de cannule, site d'Acton (Massachusetts), ~7 millions de Pods dont ~60% consommes ou expires, pas de rupture d'approvisionnement ni de revision des objectifs 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K 26/05/2026 : "Approximately 7 million Pods are included in scope, of which approximately 60% have been consumed or expired... the Company does not anticipate disruption to customer shipments, product availability or new customer starts... is not changing its previously issued 2026 guidance"

controles.affirmation: Action collective Hu v. Insulet deposee le 2 juillet 2026 au tribunal federal du Massachusetts, declarations trompeuses sur la qualite/securite Omnipod, periode 21/02/2025-26/05/2026, aucune provision comptabilisee
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 note 11 : "On July 2, 2026, a putative securities class action, Hu v. Insulet Corporation, et al. (No. 1:26-cv-13062-LTS), was filed in the U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts against the Company and certain current and former executives and directors... between February 21, 2025 and May 26, 2026... the Company does not believe that a loss is probable and, accordingly, no accrual has been recorded"
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance mineure : 'executives and directors' = dirigeants ET administrateurs, l'ATT ne dit que 'dirigeants'.

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "international regulatory, commercial and logistics business risks, including any expansion of tariffs; our dependence on a principal product platform; the impact of competitive products, technological change, and product innovation"

controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Total debt, net 948.4" et tresorerie 534,9 => dette nette 413,5 ; capitaux propres 1 422,2 => 948,4/2 370,6 = 40,0% ; tresorerie 534,9 au 30/06/2026 vs 1 121,6 au 30/06/2025 = -52,3% ; "the Company entered into accelerated share repurchase agreements (“ASRs”) to repurchase $300 million of the Company's common stock, which were completed by March 31, 2026"
